branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğumdan sonra çocuğun ardından döl yatağından bir madde çıkar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus branch carries the attributed womb and afterbirth passage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Concealed gestation, laying down, creation, and later return supply the emergence sequence.
branch_activations.activation: The branch contacts the supplied enclosure-to-emergence sequence and returns through punishment.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Punishment can be imagined as a forced passage out of concealment toward account.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus form does not lexically mean birth.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Soy zincirinde daha yakın ve öncelikli konumda bulunma anlam alanının bir bölümüdür.
branch_activations.carrier: The adjective carries the attributed birth-order or prior-position relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Creation and return supply the emergence and arrival sequence.
branch_activations.activation: Birth-order seniority contacts greater as an emergence ranked beyond an earlier position.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The harsher emergence is heard as a second arrival beyond an earlier created condition.
branch_activations.boundary: No family relation is asserted for the punished person.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed concealed-garden occurrence carries protected enclosure before emergence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus womb/afterbirth branch supplies the reversal into exposure.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punitive outcome can be pictured as emergence from a hidden enclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch has no independent registered facet in the packet.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed laying-down occurrence carries release of a burden through childbirth.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus womb and birth-order branches supply the emergence relation.
branch_activations.activation: Laying down contacts punishment as the transition out of concealment and burden.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The subject is imagined delivered into the focus's harsher consequence.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is attributed and does not make the focus a childbirth term.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed creation occurrence carries bringing a formed being into existence.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Punishment can be imagined as another forced bringing-forth into consequence.
branch_activations.boundary: Creation is a contextual trigger, not an added lexical gloss for punishment.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed return occurrence carries arrival back to the destination.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus punishment supplies the consequence before which return becomes unavoidable.
branch_activations.activation: Return contacts the emergence model and turns delivery into accountability.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The subject is brought out into punishment and then into unavoidable return and account.
branch_activations.boundary: The return branch is attributed context evidence and does not replace the ordinary sequence.

findings.title: The overcoming of false self-magnification
findings.claim: A coexisting relational reading hears the greater punishment as the overcoming of false self-magnification: attempted independence turns into abasement before rightful divine greatness.
findings.mechanism: The attributed trace joins the focus grandeur and overcoming facets to the named divine agent, punishment, turning away, concealment, and humbled-face occurrences; the adjective's relation becomes a contest of postures.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the final adjective as describing a reversal of posture as well as degree.
findings.containment: The relational contest coexists with the ordinary superlative punishment and does not claim that every refuser is lexically called arrogant.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier supplies exact focus and context coordinates, but its relational inference is explicitly exploratory.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ululuk, üstünlük ve başkalarından yukarıda olma düşüncesi anlamın temel eksenidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The adjective carries grandeur and the possibility of self-magnification.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Turning away, concealment, and the named divine agent supply the competing postures.
branch_activations.activation: Human attempted independence contacts the focus grandeur branch and produces a reversal of posture.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment can be heard as answering false self-elevation with abasement.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation is attributed and does not classify every refuser as arrogant by lexical definition.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki kişinin üstünlük için karşı karşıya gelmesi ve birinin ötekini yenmesi tek yapının iki zorunlu aşamasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The final adjective carries the attributed overcoming or defeat relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Turning away supplies attempted independence and Allah supplies the superior counterpart.
branch_activations.activation: The contest facet contacts the agent and refusal as a directional overcoming.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The greater punishment can be heard as the consequence in which false superiority is overcome.
branch_activations.boundary: No literal two-person contest is asserted beyond the attributed relational model.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ile seslenme ve ant biçimleri
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The named divine agent carries the rightful side of the greatness relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The refuser's turning and concealment supply the opposing posture.
branch_activations.activation: The divine name contacts the focus adjective and turns abstract greatness into an authority relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment stands before the rightful greatness that the refusal attempted to evade.
branch_activations.boundary: The proper name is not expanded into a generic branch or a new theological proof.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The punishment form carries the concrete means by which the posture is overcome.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjective's grandeur/overcoming relation supplies the posture contrast.
branch_activations.activation: Punishment contacts the contest model as its consequential reversal.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ordinary penal event becomes the means through which false superiority is brought low.
branch_activations.boundary: The contest relation is contextual and does not replace the ordinary punishment.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed humbled-face occurrence carries lowered submission as the reversed posture.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Focus greatness and punishment supply the consequence of the posture reversal.
branch_activations.activation: Abasement contacts the focus contest and gives the overcoming relation a visible human result.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punished side can be perceived as brought from attempted elevation into submission.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is attributed and does not define the punishment's lexical form.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed turning-away occurrence carries refusal as attempted independence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Punishment and the overcoming facet supply the reversal.
branch_activations.activation: Withdrawal contacts the contest model as the posture that is answered by consequence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment follows a posture that turns away from the rightful source of authority.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed branch does not make all turning expressions a contest.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed concealment occurrence carries active resistance to the disclosed truth.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The divine name and greatness/overcoming branches supply the answer to that resistance.
branch_activations.activation: Concealment contacts the contest as the resisted claim before which the posture reverses.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The greater punishment answers active concealment before rightful divine greatness.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch remains attributed and does not redefine disbelief as a physical act of hiding.
